$comment: Public export filter for scripts/export-public.ts (plan 5.2). A tracked path at the gate tag is exported when it matches an include glob, matches no exclude glob, and carries no tag listed in excludeTags. Globs: ** spans directories, * and ? stay within one path segment. .githooks/** is included on purpose. Files tagged executable-derived (E05 label tables, decision D2 default) are excluded until the owner decides otherwise.
